title: THING//MANIA - Menu (x3 extraction copy)
description: Loop-extraction copy of menu-mix.json: the identical 16-bar loop at bars 1, 17 and 33 (continuous, so effect tails carry across every boundary), then one closing downbeat at bar 49 that decays inside that bar. Cycle 2 (bars 17-32) is the seamless loop master; cycle 3 must be bit-identical to it.

tracks.description: A's squelch bass riff (AC-01's sound, choke and processing).
Parallel driven copy of the bass for phone speakers, low-passed at 2.2 kHz to keep 2-6 kHz free for UI sounds.
A's whistle: hook, pickups and bends, with its dotted-eighth echo.
The same whistle without the echo, for phrases that hand straight over to an appliance or a hit.
The appliance choir humming the harmony on "oo" (menu only): one pad per bar.
A's kick, locked to the bass.
A quiet backbeat on 2 and 4, no ghost notes.
The lead appliance (toaster): the ba-da-DEE tag riding the bass bend.
The kettle: the tag a fourth below the toaster.
Close-harmony appliance choir: hits, the return chord and the battery sag.
Kitchen FX: the E7 timer ding (power restored) and the kettle coming to the boil.
